A bench of CJI Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi and Justice V Mohana passed the order. Mondal was booked by West Bengal police in 1988 for the offenses under Sections 143, 448, 302 and 324 of IPC. On December 12, 1994, he was convicted under Section 302. In 2018, the Calcutta High Court dismissed his appeal against conviction.

articles.title: Why Indian exports to US are holding up despite tariffs — and what could threaten that resilience
articles.summary: India’s goods exports to the US have remained relatively steady despite tariff pressures, but the resilience masks uneven effects across sectors. Electronics and pharmaceuticals have held up better, while labour-intensive exports have faced greater pressure. With tariff uncertainty persisting and market diversification taking time, India’s ability to expand manufacturing and secure new export destinations will be critical to reducing its dependence on America.

articles.title: July core growth down to 5.4% as iron ore, power lose steam

Economists expect core and industrial output growth to moderate further due to base effects.
